RULING: PARTIES APPEARED. CLAIMANT NATALINA SIMI HEARING ON CLAIM OF RIGHT TO POSSESSION -- PARTIES REACHED A SETTLEMENT. COUNSEL FOR PLAINTIFF PUT TERMS OF SETTLEMENT ON THE RECORD AS FOLLOWS: THE PREMISES IS LOCATED AT: 227 ELLIS ST., APT. F., S. F. DEFENDANT AGREES TO VACATE THE PREMISES BY 6P.M. ON 10/14/05. THE IMPOUNDED FUND OF $450 IS TO BE DISPURSED EQUALLY TO PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT, $225@. DEFENDANT IS TO LEAVE THE APARTMENT EMPTY, FREE AND CLEAR OF ALL OCCUPANCIES, KEY TO BE RETURNED TO OWNER. NO FURTHER CLAIMS WILL BE FILED BY EACH SIDE. UPON SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, PLAINTIFF WILL DISMISS THE COMPLAINT. IF DEFENDANT VIOLATES THE AGREEMENT, IN 24 HOURS PLAINTIFF CAN FILE AN EX PARTE APPLICATION FOR IMMEDIATE REPOSSESSION OF THE PREMISES, BACK RENT, FEES AND COSTS. BEFORE DEFENDANT MOVES OUT, PLAINTIFF HAS THE RIGHT TO VISIT. PLAINTIFF IS TO SUBMIT A STIPULATION AND ORDER. (301/JLW) JUDGE JAMES L. WARREN, REPORTER CHRISTINA PAXTON CSR #1558.
